scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @campuscoin/backend && npm run build -w @campuscoin/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @campuscoin/shared" "npm run dev -w @campuscoin/backend" "npm run dev -w @campuscoin/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.clean: rimraf shared/dist backend/dist frontend/dist coverage playwright-report test-results
scripts.docker:prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile tools run --rm migrate
